resources.string: CleanYourTV profile for TCL C6K (G08). Each component is optional. Source: Gathin23/cleanyourtv, examples/tcl-65c6k-google-tv/debloat.txt (MIT). AirPlay, Cast, HDMI and input services remain available.

Choose only components you do not use. This list includes Google Assistant, Alexa, Play Games, YouTube Music, TCL channels and the TCL soundbar firmware updater. Disabling one removes its features. Backups are saved before each change. Processing stops on the first error. Use Restore to undo completed changes.
Disable selected components from the CleanYourTV TCL C6K profile and restore recorded changes. Requires local ADB.
Enable Network debugging on the TV (port 5555), then connect here. Accept the ADB key on the TV. The connection is local to this TV. Turn debugging off after cleanup.
Set this launcher as Home via ADB
Start Shizuku with ADB. Root and secondary users are not supported.
Shizuku access is unavailable. Start it and authorize this launcher.

Install Shizuku and follow its ADB setup instructions. Wireless pairing needs Wireless debugging on the TV; if the firmware lacks it, initial startup needs a computer. After a restart, Shizuku may need starting again. Return here and grant access. Close debugging after setup when no longer needed.
Storage and app cache — choose apps
Choose default launcher in launcher settings
Already disabled outside this tool; left unchanged.
No supported components found. Unknown packages are left untouched.

Play Services, Play Store, system firmware updates, HDMI, keyboard and remote services are protected. No app data is deleted. Backups stay privately on this TV; do not clear launcher data before restoring components.

This disables the stock home screen and its recommendations. First select this launcher as the system default and return here with the real Home button. Button interception alone is not enough. A private backup is saved before disabling. Use Restore here to undo.
Recommendation cards provided by this component will stop. This does not remove advertisements inside streaming apps. Save a backup and disable this component?
Restore the state recorded before freezing this component?
The operation could not finish. Nothing is retried automatically. For a stock launcher, first check the system default Home. Any saved recovery entry remains available.
